title: Item
description: One task, lecture, tutorial or exam (col "item"). Locked fields are the user's: the syncs and Claude keep the user's version of every field named in `locked`.

id.x-note: Set once, when the item is created; equals the row id. The syncs use m-<cmid>, p-<uuid>, i-<ics uid>, x-<course>-<exam>.

type.description: Lecture, Tutorial and Online unit are sessions (watched or attended); the rest are tasks.

n.description: Its number among the course's items of this type (Lecture 3).

date.description: When a session is held, or when a task is due.

endTime.x-note: Written by the Shnaton sync for exams.

link.x-note: The syncs point it at the recording of the user's group; the app also changes it when the user picks another group's recording.

note.x-note: The user's once "note" is in locked (the apps add it on every edit). Until then the syncs keep their own lines in it (exam times, rooms).

weight.x-note: The syncs write null on the items they create.
weight.description: Share of the final grade, in percent; null when unknown.

status.x-note: The user's. The Moodle sync only sets it when it creates an item, and moves todo to done when Moodle shows the task submitted. A question's effects change it when the user answers (in the app or the web app).

optional.description: Something you may skip, like an exam's Moed B: once its date passes it reads "Not taken", never "Missed".

hidden.x-note: Hidden instead of deleted, so the syncs don't add it back. The web app sets it through a question's effects.

myImportance.x-note: Claude (claude_edit.py importance) skips items where the user locked it.
myImportance.description: The user's nudge: -1 less important, 0 or null as computed, +1 more.

locked.description: The fields the user edited; the syncs and Claude keep the user's version of these.

group.description: The recording group chosen for this one week, when different from the course's usual one.

duration.x-note: Set when the item was imported; nothing changes it now.
duration.description: Length of a session in minutes (90 when missing).

meetingId.x-note: Set when the item was imported; nothing changes it now.
meetingId.description: Which of the course's weekly meetings this session belongs to.

source.description: Where it came from: user, moodle, moodle-calendar, panopto, shnaton… Set once, when the item is created.

estimate.x-note: Set when the item was imported; nothing changes it now.

doneAt.description: The day it was marked done or attended; set and cleared with status.

recordings.description: Every recording of this session, sorted by date and group.

reflection.description: What the user said after finishing it: how hard, how long, whether they followed.

rooms.x-note: Written by the Shnaton sync for exams.

secondDate.x-note: The Shnaton sync's second sitting, when it has no item of its own.

icsUid.description: The Moodle calendar event it came from.

day.description: A calendar day, "2026-11-02", or "" for none.

time.description: A time of day, "23:59", or "" for none.
